description: A small ESM/CJS library bundled with Rollup + @afterpack/rollup. The smoke serves a tiny host page that imports the OBFUSCATED ESM build and asserts its exported functions/class return the right values in chromium -- proving library builds survive obfuscation (export names + behavior preserved). The CJS build is additionally require()'d in node (see rollup-lib.spec.ts).

build.note: rollup -c emits dist/esm/lib.js + dist/cjs/lib.cjs, each obfuscated by @afterpack/rollup's writeBundle hook (build.backup:false)

interactions.description: Clicking the counter drives the obfuscated library's #private-field class and re-renders.
